facts.fact: A CENI official says that publishing all roll data could bring the CENI before the Haute autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel, naming the body under the data protection law in force in Niger.
facts.system: Haute autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel

systems.system: Haute autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: The CENI's rapporteur general says the roll is limited online in line with the law on personal data protection in force in Niger.
facts.system: loi sur la protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: The CENI official names the Haute autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel as a body that could call the CENI to account, without saying its members are appointed.
facts.system: Haute autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: The CENI says the biometric electoral file (FEB), built by Gemalto with fingerprints of ten fingers and a photo, was used for the 2020-2021 elections and holds 7,651,870 voters across 9 regions.
The CENI says an extract of enrolled voters' data (name, first name) can be consulted online on the CENI site, with full details available at CENI offices.

NER.note: The document counts voters on the electoral roll, not people holding a national ID.
The document says nothing about operation or maintenance of a national ID system.
The document concerns the electoral roll, not a national ID system.
The document does not mention police.
The document does not mention schools.
